subject: general
question: Select the INCORRECT pair.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kulhad non-biodegradable**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biodegradable** materials are those that can be broken down by **natural processes** and decomposed by microorganisms.
 
• **Kulhad** is a traditional Indian cup made from **clay**, which is an **eco-friendly** and **biodegradable** material.
 
• Since **Kulhad** is made from **natural clay**, it easily decomposes back into the soil, contributing to environmental sustainability.
 
• Using **Kulhad** helps reduce the use of **plastic** and other **non-biodegradable** materials, thereby reducing environmental pollution.
 
• In contrast, materials like **plastic** take hundreds of years to decompose and can cause significant environmental damage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Paper cup - biodegradable**__

 __
 
• **Paper cups** are typically made from **wood pulp** and are **biodegradable**.
 
• They can decompose naturally and are often **recyclable**.
 
 
 
• **Plastic glass - non-biodegradable**__
 __
 
• **Plastic glasses** are made from **synthetic polymers**, which are **non-biodegradable**.
 
• They can persist in the environment for hundreds of years, causing pollution.
 
 
 
• **Vegetable - biodegradable**__
 
 
• **Vegetables** are organic and **biodegradable**.
 
• They decompose naturally through the action of **microorganisms**.
